messages:
maria: Drafting release notes for v1.14.0 — prepping internal announce + pinned copy. Planning canary 10% then ramp if metrics look good. Target change window: Tue 03/24 21:00–22:00 UTC. Quick ask: eyeballs on copy, confirm rollback lane + model pin. cc @sre-oncall @devon

```
Release v1.14.0 (internal)
- Pin model: gptx-2-quant-v3 (avoids auto-rotation)
- Performance: reduced tail latency and improved batching heuristics
- Cost: new quantization profile for low-cost tier
- Ops: canary 10% (us-east-1), monitor 5xx and p50/p95 latency, rollback to v1.13.8 if sustained 5xx > 0.5% for 5m
```

maria: I'll post a pinned internal announce ~15m before start. Draft below for the pin: "Deploying v1.14.0 — pinned model gptx-2-quant-v3. Canary 10% then gradual ramp. See internal release doc: https://go.redwood/release/1140-draft"

jamal: looks good. tiny nit: call out the quant toggle by name so CS can explain impact, e.g., "quant-profile: low-latency-v2 (opt-in for cost savings)". Also confirm we explicitly pin the model: without the pin the catalog might rotate automatically.

devon: +1 on the pin. Rollback plan: revert rollout -> v1.13.8 and force-route traffic to fallback region eu-west-1 if latency > 300ms for 5 continuous minutes. I'll own the rollback execution. Also suggest alert: canary_5xx_rate > 0.5% for 5m triggers immediate halt + rollback.

maria: added the quant-profile line and rollback phrasing. Pushed updated snippet to docs: https://go.redwood/release/1140-draft. Queueing deploybot command when ready: `/deploy release/v1.14.0 --canary=10 --pin=gptx-2-quant-v3 --notes="internal: https://go.redwood/release/1140-draft"`

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled job created: release/v1.14.0. Canary 10% in us-east-1. Start ETA 3060056920 UTC. To cancel: `/deploy cancel 3060056920`. Logs will stream to /releases/v1.14.0 in the console.

lucy: one microcopy tweak: change "improved inference stability" -> "reduced inference timeouts under burst load" — more actionable for CS. Also add a 1-sentence customer note for CS: "No user action required; system fallback will route queries if latency spikes."

sre-oncall: I'll be on watch for the entire window. I'll create an alert dashboard and add: 1) canary_5xx_rate, 2) canary_p95_latency, 3) token_cost_anomaly. Ping me 15m before start and I'll stand by for rollback.

maria: thanks — finalizing. I'll post the pinned internal announce at 20:45 UTC (15m pre-start) and DM approvals to oncall & dev leads. Everyone ok if I merge the pinned copy now and then trigger deploybot per the scheduled start? :thumbsup:

jamal: :thumbsup:

devon: 👍 I'm good. I'll be near my laptop for rollback window.

maria: merging pinned copy now and marking ops owners. Will post the announce in #eng-releases at 20:45 UTC. Cheers.
